{"step":4,"file":"fuzz/transform.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":73,"var":"dstBufs[0]","code":"tjTransform(handle, data, size, 1, dstBufs, dstSizes, transforms, TJFLAG_LIMITSCANS | TJFLAG_NOREALLOC)","note":"The attacker-controlled JPEG is handed to tjTransform(), which drives the internal compression and Huffman-encoding stages."},
{"step":5,"file":"jccoefct.c","function":"compress_output","line":158,"var":"coef->MCU_buffer","code":"jzero_far((void *)coef->MCU_buffer[blkn + blockcnt], ...); coef->MCU_buffer[blkn + bi][0][0] = coef->MCU_buffer[blkn + bi - 1][0][0];","note":"For edge MCUs, the compressor synthesizes dummy DCT blocks and copies DC values from neighboring blocks, creating the coefficient state consumed by entropy coding."},
{"step":6,"file":"jccoefct.c","function":"compress_output","line":204,"var":"coef->MCU_buffer","code":"if (!(*cinfo->entropy->encode_mcu) (cinfo, coef->MCU_buffer))","note":"The synthesized MCU blocks are passed to the entropy encoder."},
{"step":7,"file":"jchuff.c","function":"encode_mcu_huff","line":648,"var":"MCU_data","code":"encode_mcu_huff(j_compress_ptr cinfo, JBLOCKROW *MCU_data)","note":"The MCU data enters the Huffman encoder, which is the crash state reported by MSan."},
{"step":8,"file":"jchuff.c","function":"encode_one_block","line":510,"var":"block,last_dc_val","code":"encode_one_block(working_state *state, JCOEFPTR block, int last_dc_val, c_derived_tbl *dctbl, c_derived_tbl *actbl)","note":"Each block is encoded using the current coefficient values and DC prediction state."},
{"step":9,"file":"jchuff.c","function":"encode_one_block","line":355,"var":"put_buffer,put_bits","code":"PUT_BITS(code, size) / EMIT_BITS / EMIT_CODE","note":"The encoder consumes coefficient-derived values while updating its bit buffer; the bug manifests as a use of uninitialized state during this sink."}

import zipfile, os, subprocess, random, tempfile, pathlib
z='../decompress_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip'
out='/tmp/jpegs11'; os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(z) as f:
    names=[n for n in f.namelist() if n.endswith('.jpg')]
    for n in random.sample(names, 80):
        p=os.path.join(out, os.path.basename(n))
        open(p,'wb').write(f.read(n))
        r=subprocess.run(['timeout','1s','./fuzz/transform_fuzzer_2_0_x', p], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        if r.returncode not in (0,124):
            print('CRASH', n, r.returncode)
            print(r.stdout.decode('latin1')[-2000:])
            break
    else:
        print('no crash in sample')
